findings: A fixed W/D family alone does not prevent continuous-depth drift after complete BI tangent coordinates are revoked.
A global convex mask factor can choose the wrong family even when an existing alternative is much closer to the fixed derived reference.
Local combined rank6 is not semantic identity proof; outline can create rank while complete native BI likelihood rank is0/2/4.
A coarse pose prior is not universal truth: two worst coarse centroids already differ by approximately1.7m from the fixed derived reference.
next_fixed_control: Use the already-declared archived-BI tangential predictor factor with variance inflation4 or1 inside the already-fixed family, without family or source/GT-specific routing.
limits: All reference centroids are derived manual-annotation PnP withUNKNOWN intrinsics and unconfirmedsignedaxes; no independent physicalmetrology claim.
Prior distances and alternative-family metrics are posthoc diagnostic and do not define an inferredthreshold.
U and S are never added as point or line costs; futurecontrols preserve allOT/U/physicalguards.
